803-1018-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
803-1018-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Skullwinder token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3240-4247-6277-6462.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5332-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
1981-2415-5332-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Carmen and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1818-4499-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2466-3249-5075--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1479-2841-5702-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-5702-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Springheart Nantuko and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

483-1981-2415-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature, adding {R}
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

4365-4636-5770-7824.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7296-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7296-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1978-3007-7685.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1978-3007-7685.description:
Animate Arc Reactor using Toymaker.
Activate Arc Reactor by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arc Reactor.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-4377-5531.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
1409-4377-5531.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Activate Lumra by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Lumra enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Lumra.
Repeat each turn.

206-659-4381-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
206-659-4381-4613.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

1020-2866-4659-6289.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Voyager Quickwelder.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Voyager Quickwelder.
Repeat.

3991-5256-5987.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1308-3789-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-3771-4770-6930.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2060-3771-4770-6930.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Animar and Spider-Man India trigger.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spider-Man India trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
2060-3771-4770-6930.notes: You may begin the combo with no counters on Animar if you supply an additional {1}.

1069-1256-3499-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1256-3499-5499.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

803-3951-3975-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2438-4826-5003-6644.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

372-1621-3742.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1621-3742.notablePrerequisites: Wispweaver Angel exiled by Phantom Steed
372-1621-3742.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Phantom Steed and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Wispweaver Angel returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Phantom Steed to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Phantom Steed and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Phantom Steed and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

428-804-1694-3769.notablePrerequisites:
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
428-804-1694-3769.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim. Blim triggers, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima the Impostor.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

618-2438-5887.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Werefox Bodyguard.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Werefox Bodyguard token.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

930-2997-3781-4050.description:
Cast Universal Automaton from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {1}.
When Universal Automaton dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Resolve the Zask trigger, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

2248-2979-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Patchwork Crawler does not have summoning sickness.
Trench Behemoth and Skyshroud Ranger exiled by Patchwork Crawler.
2248-2979-4543.description:
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Skyshroud Ranger's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Patchwork Crawler.
Repeat.

1506-1857-2178.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1506-1857-2178.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1931-2882-4050-4999.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to any creature you control that does not have a cycling ability.
1931-2882-4050-4999.description:
Cast Wild Dogs either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {G}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of the creature with Infinite Reflection attached.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wild Dogs, adding {G}.
If you cast Wild Dogs from your graveyard, Wild Dogs is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Wild Dogs's cycling ability.
Repeat.

2034-2724-4006-4935.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a spell this turn.
2034-2724-4006-4935.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {C}{C}.
Wormfang Manta dies, triggering its second ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conduit of Worlds by tapping it, allowing you to cast Wormfang Manta from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta enters the batltefield, but its first ability does not trigger due to Hushbringer.
Repeat each turn.

1494-1983-3313-4435.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Celestial Force triggers, causing you to gain six life.
At the beginning of your end step, Lathiel triggers, putting six +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

845-3031.description:
If a player would draw a card, that player exiles the top card of one of their opponent' libraries face down instead.
opponent can not cast any cards exiled by Shared Fate because Drannith Magistrate prevents them from casting cards form anywhere other than their hands.

757-3814-4235.notablePrerequisites: Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
757-3814-4235.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by tapping it and paying {U}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it targeting Magosi and another land of your choice.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; pay {2} and copy the Magosi ability.
Resolve both copies of the ability, cancelling out your skipped turn and taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
Repeat each turn.
